releaseNotes: Find selection actions are expanded: selecting one file now offers Share, Rename, Add to Category, and Delete; selecting multiple files offers Share, Add to Category, and bulk Delete. Delete permanently removes the selected files from the phone after confirmation and refreshes the saved Find index. Rename remains single-file only so a file can be named correctly before categorizing it. The startup grow/shrink opening transition is removed so Smart Life opens directly into Find.
